traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md specifies dual-position support for CatchClause annotations (before the catch keyword and as first comments inside the catch block) with Prettier compatibility and adjusted auto-fix behavior. The current implementation of gatherBranchCommentText and getBranchAnnotationInfo only considers comments before the node (using getCommentsBefore) and does not inspect comments inside the catch block body. Auto-fix for missing annotations inserts comments before the branch node, not inside the catch body, and there is no special handling for CatchClause. Tests for require-branch-annotation only cover annotations placed before catch, and there are no tests referencing the 025.0 story or Prettier-formatted scenarios. The rule documentation likewise lacks any mention of Prettier or dual annotation positions. Therefore, multiple acceptance criteria (inside-catch detection, fallback logic, position priority, Prettier-aware auto-fix, documentation updates) are not satisfied, so this story is not fully implemented.
